entities.summary: Li Yueru is a Chinese basketball player for the Dallas Wings of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for the Mist of Unrivaled. She also plays for the Chinese national team. Li was drafted in the third round of the 2019 WNBA draft by the Atlanta Dream.
